findings.title: Warm-up work runs as single idle-callback tasks of 0.1-0.7 s while the reader is scrolling
findings.evidence: IdleRequestCallback (chunk 3-hs4lm3bz94q.js:192, a once-guarded run-when-idle wrapper): skimmer-1440 t 7.78 s, y 2117, opening card: 708 ms of script in a 1,010 ms frame (clips #7-#9, sheet-01; it lands on 'The Crossing' act title). skimmer-1024 t 3.85 s, act-1: 320 ms; about: 155 ms. reader-1440 at the first scroll: 285 ms; journey 100 ms; films 89 ms. motion.js desktop 1440 journey 435 ms, voices 147/137 ms; native act-1 256 ms; gl voices 133 ms. Director's cut start: 96-222 ms (413abgslcjtg9.js:192) at t 3.7-6.3 s.
findings.why: An idle callback that ignores its deadline is a main-thread freeze. A real GPU does not shorten it.

findings.evidence: A 63/64 ms PerformanceObserverCallback (no script URL) sits exactly at intro:hold in both reader screencasts and is absent from motion.js, so it is harness/debug overhead. The §4.4 hand-off, landing-raster and name-frame rows were not re-measured. Run-to-run spread was not measured, and single-section rows rest on 12-17 frames. The real-GPU row is unmeasured. findings.why: This is context for the triage.

recommendations: 1. No long task while the page moves. Split all warm-up and deferred setup (the idle-callback work, 0.1-0.7 s today) into slices that yield within the idle deadline. Pause the warm-up ladder while the page is scrolling and while an act card is in its set piece.

2. Make the post-titles quiet window hold when the intro is skipped. quiet-end must not come before hydration finishes. Hydrate below-the-fold sections later or in smaller pieces so the first 3 s of a fling meet no task over 50 ms.

3. Stop the whole-page re-measure on content resizes. Re-measure only what changed, or only on a real viewport resize. Keep content heights stable after load so the 100-320 ms re-measure never fires mid-scroll.

4. Cut raster where the reader actually is: make the Map of the principles (B54) one static layer that moves by transform; stop card stages painting outside their window (act-3 through films and beyond, act-4 through writing, principles and contact); stop and hide the hero video once it leaves the screen; finish raster-diet items 3 (journey sticky) and 6 (voices campSticky).
5. Lighten the opening card: pause off-screen infinite animations and drop will-change from layers that are not moving, so its 18 layers and 14 loops do not all raster while it plays.
6. Journey must go quiet at rest: whatever repaints there while still (idle 0.5 / 20.5 fps) should stop when the page is not moving.
7. Films: stagger the Motion-driven entrances so no frame runs 64-175 ms of animation script.

8. Close CLS to 0: the scrubbed sentence in beyond reserves its final layout; world-face film names in scene captions swap without changing metrics; the hero compass reserves its box on the play screen.
9. GL: switch tier only at p ends (the 1024 tintype flash), and compile or upload before the ignite card, not inside it (the 934 ms frame in the gl run).
10. Let the intro name arrive with a short fade or wipe that still reads at low frame rates, not a one-frame cut.

11. Measurement: run the §12.1 real-GPU row on Aryan's laptop, which is the actual target. Re-run the §4.4 intro trace (hand-off, landing raster, name frame). Take 3 runs per width before acting on single-section rows. Keep the harness's PerformanceObserver cost out of the intro count.
